source_text: Anima quae tetigerit morticinum aut a fera captum immunda est. Conversatio mortua immunditiam affert. Separare sanctum ab immundo.
pass_a_gloss: Soul which will-have-touched carcass or by-beast caught unclean is. Way-of-life dead uncleanness brings. To-separate holy from unclean.
pass_b_english: Whoever touches a [[carcass or what a beast has taken >> Bible:Leviticus 5:2]] is unclean. Dead habits bring uncleanness. Learn to separate holy from unclean.
